data.narrative:
AGent Energy is a Seed-stage private company in the Climate & Energy sector, having raised $6M to date. The valuation universe comprises 9 peer companies across climate and energy—1 public (LNZA) and 8 private entities including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—though no peers share AGent Energy's exact stage and valuation tier.

Given data constraints, only the stage-progression method is applicable. This approach uses the $6M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A progression, yielding $15M. A peer-median approach could not be applied; while 9 same-sector companies exist, filtering for matching stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier produced zero qualifying comparables—the minimum threshold for reliable triangulation is three datapoints. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial noise and was rejected.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $13M to $17M, centered at $15M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include: (1) the appropriateness of 2.5x as AGent Energy's step-up multiplier absent founder track record or revenue data; (2) whether Climate & Energy peers trade at stage multiples comparable to broader venture markets; and (3) product maturity and competitive positioning relative to the named peer set. Additional fundraising data or comparable seed rounds in narrower subsectors would materially improve confidence in this estimate.
